content: Choi, are you ready for the World Cup match on Monday?
I can't wait, Dad! Argentina versus France — it's going to be epic.
I'm so excited to see Messi play. He's going to lead Argentina to victory! I'm a big fan of his.
We'll see about that. Mbappé is in top form, and France is going to win! Mbappé is my favorite player.
No way! Argentina will win with a score of 3-1. What's your prediction?
I bet France will win with a score of 2-1. It's going to be a close match.
You're on! Loser of the bet will buy dinner at 'King Star'.
Deal! Get ready to pay for that fine-dining experience, Dad.
We'll see, Choi. It's going to be a great match no matter who wins.
Absolutely, Dad. Let's enjoy it together!
